newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on CBOT, wheat limit down.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on CBOT, wheat limit down.

text.p: WCE canola ended down on CBOT soycomplex weakness and feed wheat ended limit down on the lower Canadian Wheat Board price forecast, traders said.

"There was no buying except for commercial bull spreading of about 350 Jan-March at even money and Chicago was weak," a trader said. Mar-July spread at even money, Jan-July at even money, Jan-May $1. January futures crush profit margin rose to -37.44 from -37.95 Wednesday on January soyoil, meal. Volume was 5,710 lots with 250 hedges.
Japan bought 2,000-3,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
Commercials selling pushed January flax down $0.70 to $364 and commercials spread 50 Jan-Mar at $1.50. Volume was 170 lots and 50 hedges.

December feed wheat fell the $5 limit to $167.50 on lower CWB feed wheat price forecasts, March lost $5 to $169.40 with UGG the featured seller, traders said. Dec-Mar spread $1.50. About 1,000 contracts traded. Peas and oats did not trade.
February western barley lost $0.70 to $139 on the CWB's lower feed barley prices Thursday, March fell $1.20 to $138. Feb-May spread $0.50, July-Oct $3.50.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
